kind: Indexed map legend and camera-derived center breadcrumbs, deployed and remeasured
changes: Legend uses branch-pruned visible areas and actual nonempty rendered symbols, sharing the cached visible set with map chunk selection.

Center breadcrumb follows the current camera through a containing-branch query, preserving the original strict opacity threshold and fixed world coordinates. The old independent location state and onMoveEnd scan are deleted.
Breadcrumb is an absolute canvas overlay. Its appearance does not resize the canvas or interrupt normal-motion focus.
